name: civiccast-control-room-tsr-service
description: CivicCast-owned localhost sidecar that drives production switchers (OBS / vMix / ATEM / HyperDeck / PTZ / OSC / CasparCG) via TSR (timeline-state-resolver, MIT). The CivicCast Python control plane is the only caller (bound to 127.0.0.1). No GPL/AGPL device-control source is vendored here — TSR is MIT, and devices like OBS are reached only over their own socket protocols by TSR, never linked.
